lean.statement:
∀ (m : ℝ) (_hm : 0 < m),
    let μ := (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) • gaussianReal (-m) 1 + (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) • gaussianReal m 1
    let ν := (1 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞) • gaussianReal (-m) 1 + (3 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞) • gaussianReal m 1
    ENNReal.ofReal (m / 2) ≤ WassersteinSpace.wassersteinDistance μ ν ∧
      WassersteinSpace.wassersteinDistance μ ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal m
approved_definition_context: gaussianReal a v is the actual real Borel Gaussian probability measure with mean a and variance v.
Weighted sums here are scalar multiples and addition of measures, not a new variable or a joint law.
WassersteinSpace.wassersteinDistance is the square root of the infimum of integrated squared norm displacement over measures with the specified two marginals.
ENNReal.ofReal embeds nonnegative real numbers without change.
